thread:
Maya Patel: Hey team — I pushed the follow-ups for the routing-fallback change. Addressed @AJ Chen's rename suggestion, added a unit test for the new fallback path, and split the big change into two commits to keep history cleaner. PTAL when you have a minute: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/842

AJ Chen: Thanks — checking now. Quick skim looks good, will leave inline comments for the two nits I found.

AJ Chen: Left comments: 1) rename var -> routePriority to match conventions, 2) tiny doc nit in the READMEs. Nothing blocking.

Maya Patel: Thanks @AJ — fixed both and pushed. Also added a short smoke script to the PR description so SRE can run a quick verification: 
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --env=staging --route=dynamic-fallback
```
PTAL again.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅ (unit tests, lint, integration smoke).

Sara Lee: Running the smoke locally against the staging stack now. Will report back in ~10m.

AJ Chen: LGTM from my side once the smoke passes. One process question: do we want to squash these commits or preserve the split history?

Maya Patel: I prefer keeping the commits (split made reasoning clearer), but if release wants a squash I'm fine to do it. Won't change behaviour.

Sara Lee: Smoke looks good on my end — no perf regresses and fallback path exercised.

Sara Lee: If everyone agrees, I can merge, but we need a merge custodian since it's outside my usual window. @Ryan Kim — can you take merge ops at ~11:30 PT?

Ryan Kim: I can take it. I'll schedule merge at 11:30 PT after the canary window and monitor the rollout.

Maya Patel: Awesome, thanks @Ryan. I've added a post-merge checklist in the PR description (tagging docs and whoever owns the routing dashboard).

Ryan Kim: Merged at 11:31 PT. Had to rebase to resolve a tiny conflict, pushed the resolved commit. All CI green on the merged commit.

Maya Patel: Perfect — thanks everyone :tada: I’ll send a follow-up with the changelog excerpt and update the rollout dashboard link.
